rule: The respeeded NARA mix places its voice at the GET of its time code. Where the voice heard in the mix comes from a track on the other head row than the time code, it is late by the row gap (0.683 s at the NARA tape speed). True GET of a word = mix GET - voice_late_s. 'intervals' (GET seconds) override the tape value inside them. A tape with voice_late_s null is fitted with a free offset (prior_sigma_s) and must be reviewed.
row_gap_basis: file splits between timecode and programme placement on 608 (-679.8 ms), 644 (-684.2), 646 (+683.7), 650 (-683.3), 652 (-684.3); overlap steps 641-640 +0.678, 646-645 -0.680 s
